This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
 every 8000 operating hours as indicated by H8000 in the title block.

The pump function is provided with the boilers required fuel and with required 
 pressure.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Saad Younes, reviewed & tested by 
 eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah Mohamed Shehata, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar: Head Sector of Kafr Eldawar Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control head sector.

items: A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Grease gun
Alignment device, Turbo oil 32
Uncouple the motor from the pump by removing the coupling bolts.
Check and record the alignment and the axial clearance.
Drain the oil from guide bearing.
Inspect and clean the oil cooler.
Inspect and repack the gland with a new packing if required.
Inspect and clean the cooling water tubes.
Inspect the butterfly valve
Inspect pump shaft and sleeves for repairing or replace it if required.
Inspect guide bearing for repairing or replace it if required.
Inspect the impellers for corrosion and replace it if required.

Inspect the impellers wear rings and casing rings for repairing or replace it 
 if required.
Inspect the pump foundation.
Realign the motor to the pump.
Adjust the axial clearance.
Reconnect the coupling bolts.

Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
 every 8000 operating hours as indicated by H8000 in the title block.
The pump function is provided with the boilers required fuel and with required 
 pressure.
Technical Specification :
Speed | 370 RPM

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Saad Younes, reviewed & tested by

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding

Work to be Carried Out
Main Cooling Pump

Check and record the alignment and the axial clearance.
Drain the oil from guide bearing.
Inspect and clean the oil cooler.

Inspect and clean the cooling water tubes.
Inspect the butterfly valve
